short_description: The ICLR 2025 pipeline of neel-dey/anatomix at a pinned commit, through its own convex_adam() with the defaults of its script: 16 anatomix and 12 MIND-SSC channels compared by SSD, diffusion weight 0.75, convex grid 2 with search half-width 1, 80 Adam steps on a grid of 2; CT clipped to [-450, 450] HU. The ImagingBenchmarks baseline anatomix_convexadam.
description: The ICLR 2025 pipeline of neel-dey/anatomix at a pinned commit, through its own convex_adam() with the defaults of its script: 16 anatomix and 12 MIND-SSC channels compared by SSD, diffusion weight 0.75, convex grid 2 with search half-width 1, 80 Adam steps on a grid of 2; CT clipped to [-450, 450] HU. The ImagingBenchmarks baseline anatomix_convexadam. The pair must be aligned (rigidly for one patient, by an affine transform between two subjects): only the deformable stage runs. The weights come from the authors' Hugging Face repository at a pinned revision. A GPU is needed. Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS).
